arguments.query: select p.proname, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as args from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and (p.proname like 'fn_devolver_ingredientes%' or p.proname like 'fn_cancelar_item_pedido%' or p.proname like 'fn_eliminar_producto_orden%') order by 1
